nodes.confirmCordonBody: No new session is placed on this node. Sessions already running there keep running.
nodes.consequenceCordon: {{count}} GPUs stop accepting new work until the node is uncordoned.
nodes.drainNote: Draining cordons the node and then reschedules or terminates its sessions. It is the step before maintenance or scaling down.
nodes.emptyDescription: Nodes are reported by the cluster operator's inventory controller; none has checked in yet.

orgs.confirmDelete: Delete organization "{{name}}"? It is refused while it still has groups.
orgs.consequenceCredits: Credits held in its wallet return to the system pool and its ledger history is unavailable.
orgs.emptyDescription: An organization is the top of the hierarchy: it holds groups, budgets and the credit pool they draw from.

orgs.statusHint: An inactive organization keeps its data but cannot start new sessions.

resources.billingNote: Actual charge = rate × occupancy (whichever of VRAM and cores is higher) × time. A CPU offering has a rate of 0, and the session is billed in proportion to its CPU, memory, and disk.
resources.confirmDeleteOffering: Delete offering "{{name}}"? It is refused while a session still references it.
resources.consequenceGlobalPolicy: Every scope without its own policy loses its limits entirely — no concurrency cap, no idle timeout, no maximum runtime.
resources.consequenceOffering: Running sessions keep the rate they were priced at. New sessions can no longer choose this offering.
resources.consequencePolicy: This scope falls back to the policy above it.
resources.consequencePreset: The preset disappears from the session wizard. Sessions already created are unaffected.
resources.cpuOfferingNote: A CPU offering's rate is fixed at 0; the session is billed in proportion to its CPU, memory, and disk.
resources.kindGpuOption: GPU (a per-model fraction of VRAM and cores)
resources.offeringsNote: GPU catalogue rates in credits per hour, billed by occupancy. Modes: fractional, exclusive, MIG.
resources.policyMergeNote: Layered policies merge to the strictest value (organization → project → user). max_concurrent and max_queued are independent ceilings.
resources.policyNote: Layered quotas across organization, project, and user — the most restrictive wins.
resources.presetComputeNote: A compute preset sets the session's CPU, memory, and disk.
resources.presetGpuNote: A GPU preset's actual VRAM is the selected model's full card multiplied by the fraction.
resources.presetVramNote: A GPU preset's VRAM is computed as a fraction of the selected model's full-card capacity, per model.
resources.presetsNote: Compute (CPU, memory, disk) and GPU (a per-model fraction) are defined separately, and chosen separately in the wizard.
resources.subtitle: Offering catalogue · presets · resource policy (quotas)
resources.title: Resource settings
resources.uniqueNote: (scope, scope_id) is unique; a duplicate returns 409 conflict.
